sources.entry: sbtfix - Menu bar app to control Sony headphones: noise cancelling, ambient sound, Speak-to-Chat and battery.

summary.one_liner: A native macOS menu-bar app that controls Sony headphones and earbuds over Bluetooth, letting you switch noise cancelling, ambient sound and off modes, adjust ambient level, toggle Focus on Voice and Speak-to-Chat, and check battery.
summary.what_it_does: sbtfix sits in the macOS menu bar and talks to Sony headphones directly over Bluetooth RFCOMM, using a framed binary protocol rather than Sony's phone app, which has no Mac version. It switches between Noise Cancelling, Ambient Sound and Off, with Wind Noise Reduction on models that support it. It offers an ambient level slider (1–20), Focus on Voice, and Speak-to-Chat on/off. It shows battery level with a charging indicator, including left, right and case for earbuds. It detects the model and protocol generation automatically and only shows the features that model supports, and it stays in sync when the buttons on the headphones are used. The README says it reconnects automatically when the headphones connect.
use_cases: control Sony headphone noise cancelling from a Mac
switch to ambient sound without using the phone
check Sony earbud battery levels on macOS
adjust ambient sound level on Sony headphones
replace Sony Headphones Connect app on Mac
how_to_run: Download sbtfix.zip from the latest release and unzip it
Right-click the app, choose Open, then click Open again (or run: xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/sbtfix.app)
Click Allow when macOS asks for Bluetooth access
Build from source: git clone the repo, cd sbtfix, then ./build.sh (use ./build.sh --install to also copy to /Applications)
Pair and connect headphones in macOS Bluetooth settings, then click the menu bar headphones icon
notable: Talks to headphones directly over Bluetooth, reproducing the phone app's protocol without a vendor Mac app
Automatically detects model and protocol generation and shows only supported controls
Menu-bar icon reflects current noise cancelling/ambient mode
No Dock icon, no background daemons, no network access, no dependencies
Protocol framing and commands documented in docs/PROTOCOL.md; protocol support credited to Gadgetbridge research
caveats: Only WH-1000XM5 is marked as tested; most other models are listed as expected to work but unconfirmed on a Mac
The app is not notarized, so macOS blocks it on first launch and needs a manual workaround
Unofficial project, not affiliated with Sony; provided as-is with no warranty
